decision: Accept unchanged observations from two independent pinned-original runs and a byte-identical installed v0.25 control, before implementing an admission runtime. Historical investigation labels in the raw helper/output envelopes remain provenance and are superseded by this record.
scope: 126 actor input courses and 11 native World courses: ordered admission, lazy ammunition creation, first-gate identity, live state/content/config changes, native reload/reflex/guard/trigger/summon use and qualified-target/corpse side effects.
correctionsBeforeAcceptance: The first small investigation used malformed synthetic empower:{}; the retained SDK correctly rejected it. A finite numeric 0.2 replaced it before these captures.
A full gauge can satisfy readiness during its feed lock; the assumption that every gauge lock blocks casting was rejected against original code and behavior.
Status refusal reads skillContextTags(inst); a socket grant is not implicitly appended to that context. The initial expectation of a combined granted-tag set was rejected.
A second guard combo press must wait for the original body recovery. The native course now observes both the immediate refusal and the subsequent frame-earned success.
limitations: Primitive state/definition injections are explicit and include synthetic cases. Native World courses seed resources, banks and selected status/minion records; this is not mounted UI or target-device evidence.

Internal method-entry traces are diagnostic. Runtime refactors may change internal dispatch but must preserve gameplay state/results, first refusal identity, lazy mutations and effectful host-port order; any trace projection requires a separately documented adapter decision.
This acceptance adds no extracted admission runtime, native engine package, performance claim, SDK version bump or public-main promotion.
